rest-module-produnto.v1-description: API for the Produnto package manager
rest-endpoint-desc-get-produnto-deployme: Get a list of recent deployments, including the active deployment if any.
rest-endpoint-desc-post-produnto-deploym: Validate a proposed new set of package versions.
Make changes to the deployed set of package versions.
rest-endpoint-desc-get-produnto-packages: The index to a list of all fetched package versions.
A list of fetched package versions within a partition.
rest-endpoint-desc-post-produnto-gitlab-: A GitLab webhook handler for the tag event. See [the GitLab documentation](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/integrations/webhook_events/#tag-events).
rest-endpoint-desc-get-produnto-sandbox-: List the sandboxes for the current user.
rest-endpoint-desc-post-produnto-sandbox: Create or modify a sandbox in the current user session.
rest-endpoint-desc-delete-produnto-sandb: Delete a sandbox from the current user session.
rest-endpoint-desc-post-produnto-sandbox: Activate a sandbox in the session context so that its packages will be used on preview.
Deactivate a sandbox so that its packages will no longer be used on preview.
rest-property-desc-produnto-partition-hr: The relative URL of the partition; the partition parameter to the list endpoint
rest-property-desc-produnto-partition-st: The lowest possible package ID in the partition
rest-property-desc-produnto-partition-en: The highest possible package ID in the partition
rest-property-desc-produnto-packages: A list of all fetched package versions in the partition
rest-property-desc-produnto-deployment-i: The ID of the deployment, pd_id.
rest-property-desc-produnto-deployment-c: The wiki ID of the initiating action.
rest-property-desc-produnto-deployment-r: The revision ID of the initiating action.
rest-property-desc-produnto-deployment-a: Whether the deployment is active by default on the wiki.
rest-property-desc-produnto-deployment-p: Map of package name to deployed version.
rest-property-desc-produnto-deployment-u: The name of the initiating user.
rest-property-desc-produnto-deployment-t: The ISO-8601 combined date and time of when the deployment was created.
rest-property-desc-produnto-deployment-s: The edit summary or comment supplied by the initiating user.
rest-property-desc-produnto-package-id: The package ID (ppv_id) identifying the name/version pair.
rest-property-desc-produnto-package-fetc: An internal URL used when the package was fetched. May be an empty string or otherwise invalid.
rest-property-desc-produnto-package-upst: A string identifying the upstream package version. For packages fetched from Git, this will be a git ref. For packages fetched from elsewhere, this may be an empty string or otherwise not unique.
rest-property-desc-produnto-package-desc: A short localised description of the package.
rest-property-desc-produnto-package-home: The URL of the package homepage. Optional: use collabUrl and docUrl if there is no separate homepage. This is the `url` property from the package manifest.
rest-property-desc-produnto-package-coll: The URL of a human-readable entry point for source code review and contributions. For example, a GitLab project page.
rest-property-desc-produnto-package-doc-: The URL of the documentation page.
rest-property-desc-produnto-package-issu: The URL of the package's bug tracker.
rest-property-desc-produnto-package-lice: SPDX identifier for the license under which the package is released.
rest-property-desc-produnto-package-modu: A map of each global Scribunto module name to its implementing file, relative to the package root.
rest-property-desc-produnto-package-stat: The fetch state of the package
rest-property-desc-produnto-package-erro: Errors which occurred while fetching the package and parsing its manifest file
rest-property-desc-produnto-message-tran: An array mapping the MediaWiki language code to the translation in that language.
rest-property-desc-produnto-sandbox-size: The size of the sandbox in bytes, counted towards a per-user limit
rest-property-desc-produnto-sandbox-mtim: The ISO 8601 combined date and time of last modification
rest-property-desc-produnto-sandbox-acti: Whether the sandbox is used on preview
rest-property-desc-produnto-sandbox-ok: Whether the sandbox has all file contents and is ready to use.
rest-property-desc-produnto-sandbox-miss: The hashes of files that were not found in the database or in previously posted sandbox update requests.
rest-property-desc-produnto-validate-ok: This will be true if there were no errors, even if there were warnings. Warnings are significant and need to be acknowledged by the user before deployment.
rest-property-desc-produnto-validate-war: An array of warnings. This should be empty before proceeding with an automated deployment.
rest-param-desc-produnto-patch-packages: JSON serialized object mapping package names to versions. If a deployed package is absent, it will remain unchanged. If a version is null or the empty string, that package will be undeployed.
rest-param-desc-produnto-patch-ignore-wa: Whether to ignore validation warnings, such as package requirements not satisfied.
rest-param-desc-produnto-sandbox-hash:
An associative array of associative arrays, with the package name in the first key, the path in the second key and the lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 hash of the file contents of that path as the value. For example `hash[package1][src/init.lua]=e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855`

All hashes present in the sandbox must be sent in every request. File deletion is done by omitting a hash.

NOTE: OpenAPI and Swagger do not support this format. We present a schema here as a rough human-readable explanation of the request body.
rest-param-desc-produnto-sandbox-file:
An array of files posted as multipart, where the name of each file is of the form `file[<hash>]` where `<hash>` is the SHA-256 hash of the content as referenced in the `hash` parameter.

It is optional to post the contents of a file. The server will respond with a list of missing hashes so that the client can post them on demand.

NOTE: OpenAPI and Swagger do not support this format. We present a schema here as a rough human-readable explanation of the request body.
rest-param-desc-produnto-sandbox-post-id: An arbitrary user-scoped identifier for the sandbox being created or updated.
rest-param-desc-produnto-validate-packag: Map of package names to versions. All packages to be deployed must be included, including packages which will be unchanged.
